patterns.note: Long-form, single-page editorial layout with generous vertical spacing and centered content blocks, creating an airy and focused reading experience.
A clear typographic hierarchy featuring a large, elegant display serif font for main titles, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and subheadings.

A warm, muted background palette (light beige) provides a calm canvas, against which vibrant, illustrative accent colors are used extensively within custom data visualizations and detailed illustrations.

Scroll-triggered reveals: Content sections and individual elements (text blocks, charts, illustrations) animate into view with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport.

Hero parallax: The decorative bird illustrations surrounding the main title in the hero section move at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect as the user scrolls down.
Extensive use of custom, colorful data visualizations and detailed bird illustrations integrated directly into the content flow, acting as visual anchors and engaging section dividers.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling experience (likely using locomotive-scroll) combined with scroll-triggered animations. As the user scrolls, content blocks and visual elements are revealed with a gentle fade and a slight upward slide.
The initial hero section features background elements that parallax, moving at a different speed than the foreground text, to create a sense of depth.
Large, custom illustrations and data visualizations are integrated full-width or near full-width, often appearing with a gentle animation as they come into view.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant display heading (~3-4x body) for the main title, with clear, slightly smaller sans-serif subheadings and readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (mostly square edges for content blocks and images, though illustrations are organic).
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in the hero and between major content sections, creating a relaxed and editorial feel.

standout: The site's standout feature is its seamless integration of highly detailed, custom bird illustrations and sophisticated data visualizations directly into a long-form editorial piece. This creates a visually rich and engaging narrative that elevates the content beyond a typical article, making it feel like an interactive report or a digital art piece.
